name: A Knight
bio: Archetype: AoE DPT, ST DPT, Snowball. ⌽ Insights provide DMG Bonus and Penetration Rate based on enemy missing HP. ⌽ Killing an enemy with Ultimate applies [Rousing Morale] to the team. ⌽ Skill 1 grants bonus Moxie on kill and Skill 2 grants bonus moxie at higher ranks, allowing faster Ult cycles. ⌽ Kill condition makes for an extremely greedy carry. ⌽ Excels in stages with multiple enemies or waves that allow better Ult cycling.
